QuestionStmt.S: If $$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 & 4 \\ 1 & 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 12 \\ 15 \\ 13 \end{bmatrix}$$ then the value of $x^2 + y^2 + z^2 =$

Solution.S:
$$AX = B$$

$$\Rightarrow \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 & 4 \\ 1 & 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 12 \\ 15 \\ 13 \end{bmatrix}$$

Applying $R_2 \to R_2 - R_1$ and $R_3 \to R_3 - R_1$,

$$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 12 \\ 3 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}$$

$$\therefore \quad x + 3y + 3z = 12 \quad \dots (i)$$

$$y + z = 3 \quad \dots (ii)$$

$$z = 1$$

From (ii), $y + 1 = 3 \Rightarrow y = 2$.

From (i), $x + 6 + 3 = 12 \Rightarrow x = 3$.

$$\therefore \quad x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 9 + 4 + 1 = 14$$
